أحتشي (form VIII)
# أَحْتَشِي (ʔaḥtašī) /ʔaħ.ta.ʃiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# أَحْتَشِيَ (ʔaḥtašiya) /ʔaħ.ta.ʃi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
